title: ToolCallRequest
description: A model's request to use one tool. The name is drawn from a closed set: there is no shell, no arbitrary fetch, no SQL, no code execution and no generic network tool, so a request for one is not a refused capability but an unrepresentable document.

tool.description: Every tool reads. None writes, and none reaches the network or a target. The model cannot cause an observation to be collected, a score to change, or a host to be contacted.
